create_solver_ate: create an ATE solver instance with configurable Tsallis entropy parameter and learning rates
init_solver_vars: initialize solver variables with number of strategies and players for Nash equilibrium computation
compute_gradients_ate: compute exploitability gradients and regularized exploitability estimates for all players
run_mirror_descent_step: run entropic mirror descent step to update policy distributions toward approximate Nash equilibrium
evaluate_exploitability: evaluate Tsallis entropy regularized exploitability of current policy distribution
